method: Manual whole-file source reading; all five files byte-compared with pinned Git objects. No upstream tests executed.
findings: DuplicateContent constructs 2MiB identical copies and a same-prefix file altered at 1MiB+211, compares exported duplicates with independent whole-file Get-FileHash results, and checks source hashes remain unchanged. Both SHA256 and xxHash scenario registrations explicitly disable SampleLargeFiles. This does not cover the above-64MiB sampling branch.
Roundtrip scenarios for CSV/JSON mutate a source file and create a new file after export, then check loading preserves the saved model and explicit refresh sees current disk state.
Malformed report scenarios reject pointer-backed hardlink type masks 0x30000200 and 0x30000204. Quiet CLI failure, malformed integer-list settings and ACL CSV/JSON parity are separate scenarios.

Desktop capture reads actual screen pixels with BitBlt rather than WM_PRINT, requests per-monitor DPI context, rejects off-desktop rectangles, and releases GDI resources in finally. Difference ignores alpha and changes up to tolerance8 per RGB channel, counts changed pixels, and returns1 on dimension mismatch. This is a rendering regression metric, not duplicate-file identity.

Runner requires PowerShell7.6 and Windows for execution, records executable version/hash through shared reporting path, supports seeded shuffling/repeat, and distinguishes skipped scenarios via RequireAll exit3. Default exit0 may include skips.

Whole Core.ps1 confirms failed scenarios retain evidence; successful scenarios require at least one assertion. Capability skips occur before body execution, cleanup errors mark FAIL, cleanup callbacks run in reverse order. Write-TestReports computes executable SHA256 and emits JSON/JUnit, with exit precedence FAIL1, noPASS2, RequireAll plus skips3, otherwise0.

ScriptSupport numeric parsers support literal decimal/hex defines and sequential line-oriented enums, not general C expressions. Map function sizes use distances between adjacent symbol RVAs with final symbol size0; these are estimates, not measured function body sizes or runtime performance.
limits: Source review only: no Windows executable, UI, ACL, filesystem or PowerShell scenario execution in this increment.
Fixtures.ps1 and Ui.ps1 remain unread as whole files; scenario assertions do not independently qualify those helper implementations.
Desktop Difference assumes consistent pixel buffer lengths and dimensions supplied by its capture path; no malformed TestFrame runtime controls performed.
Native pHash memory-error investigation remains deferred; no production code adopted.
